name: Cal.diy
description: Cal.diy is an open-source scheduling platform. This repository provides both LXC and VM deployment scripts for Proxmox VE.
author: Sofiane Touati (https://github.com/sofianetouati)

install_methods.description: Creates a Debian 12 LXC container and installs Cal.diy with Docker Compose. Lightweight option suitable for testing and moderate workloads.
Creates a Debian 12 VM with Docker pre-installed and automatically builds Cal.diy on first boot. Recommended for production deployments that require full kernel capabilities.

notes: For production, prefer the VM deployment (KVM) over LXC, as Docker officially recommends full VMs for production workloads.
The VM installer pre-installs Docker via virt-customize and runs the Cal.diy build as a first-boot service (~30-40 min build time).
Set a public URL reachable by users, ideally behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
The installer can use the local PostgreSQL service from the Docker Compose stack or a remote PostgreSQL database.
Use caldiy-update for application updates and caldiy-logs to follow logs (available after installation).
